text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp season had arrived.
For Mejiro Ryan, a season of both rest and leveling up was about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We're starting already!? Even though last year
I stumbled right from the get-go!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Far from being a lady, I'm practically at a toddler's level when it comes to romance, but you'd still consider me!?
There was nothing else I could really say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you say so, Trainer,
maybe things will work out somehow, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right. I'm not who I used to be either.
I'm pretty popular now, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: My muscles are totally pumped up, so there's no way my chatter is gonna bomb on stage!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "T-T-Trainer-san... M-M-My legs are totally shaking, though-ugh-ugh..."
"Though they try to put on a brave face, their muscles tremble, and the aftershocks shake the entire training camp lodge."

If she gains some confidence in romance,
maybe this shaking will stop too.
